summary: AIM ImmunoTech filed an 8-K reporting two exchange agreements with Streeterville Capital converting roughly $400,000 of a November 18, 2025 promissory note into 1,749,434 common shares at an average price near $0.228, under a Section 3(a)(9) exemption. Stockholders had already approved debt conversion at a July 15, 2026 special meeting per NYSE American Sections 713(a)/(b). No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine debt-for-equity exchange, not a special situation; watch dilution, note amortization pace and AIM's residual cash runway.
